events.title: SLV High School Boys Golf Team Fundraiser Scramble
events.location: Boulder Creek Golf & Country Club, 16901 Big Basin Highway, Boulder Creek
events.description: Four-person scramble with a 3:30 pm shotgun start, raising money for the San Lorenzo Valley High School boys golf team. Entry is $100, $150 or $200 a player and every tier gets the same package: green fee, a spaghetti feed with a soft drink, a hat and a sleeve of logo'd balls, and a donation to the team that grows with the tier. Carts and adult beverages are separate. Sign up with a team name to stay together, or as a single and the club will pair you. Contests for the winning team, closest to the pin and long drive, plus a silent auction and a 50/50 raffle at $10 a ticket sold in person. Hole sponsorships are $200. The team's season goal is $8,300.
events.notice: Register in advance. Entry from $100 a player, spaghetti feed included, carts extra. Questions to events@bouldercreekgolf.com or 831-338-2111.
